name: Ord Tessebok
description: Ord Tessebok was a Mid Rim planet situated in the Irishi sector. Serving as a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost during the Pius Dea Era, millennia later it loosened its immigration restrictions for people displaced by the Separatist Crisis. Eventually the planet became a part of the New Republic.
